svg.text: Sleeping Giant: where destroyer smoke pays, by grid cell (team-normalized)

32 games, 238 destroyer smokes. Map average: 11.9k concealed damage per smoke, 12 deaths per 100, cap won 19%. Cells with 8+ smokes are rated; dashed = small n (8 to 14); grey number = n too small to rate.
high cell: 1.4x map average or more
low cell: 0.6x map average or less (left panel only)
